history.period: CONFLICT - the crowdsourced listing's header claims c. 1940 CE, but its own visit narrative says the temple priest described it as built 'relatively recently, in the late 20th century'; UNVERIFIED
history.summary: A small community Ram temple on a hill overlooking Lunglei town (PIN 796701). One crowdsourced heritage listing describes it as a predominantly white structure with a sloping roof reminiscent of traditional Mizo houses and a curvilinear North-Indian-style shikhara, serving Lunglei's small Hindu community. CAUTION: the same listing's 'construction technique' section describes visiting the 'Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama, Lunglei, locally known as Rama Mandir' - it may have conflated two different places (UNVERIFIED). Its claims of ASI protection and of 17th-18th-century temple excavations are spurious, and the 'Bengal Renaissance Period' label should not be repeated as fact. Coordinates (22.894508, 92.745589) come from that listing and are approximate (verify). No reliable image of the actual temple was found after genuine searching.

name: Rama Mandir
town_description: Lunglei is the second-largest town in Mizoram and the headquarters of Lunglei district. It grew from a British military outpost established in 1888 into a major administrative centre of the southern hills. Its population is overwhelmingly Mizo and Christian; the small Hindu minority maintains a few modest community temples.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl), approx. 175-190 km by road (verify).
travel.railway: No railway near Lunglei (verify); nearest railhead likely Sairang or Bairabi in northern Mizoram.
travel.road: Approx. 170 km from Aizawl via NH 54, with regular buses and jeeps (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather (15-25 C, per listing); Ram Navami (March-April) for the main festival (verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Listed as 6:00 AM-12:00 PM and 4:00-9:00 PM daily, with aarti at 7:00 AM, 12:00 PM and 7:00 PM, free entry (verify - single uncorroborated crowdsourced listing).
